description: Gripper 3.x: build the base/drive assembly that the grippers attach to. From the key reference photo (cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_closed.png and references/generalist): the black handles extend back behind the yellow fingers, wrap around, and connect into a common base. A single motor is mounted underneath that base; it spins and drives gears attached to the black handles, which opens and closes the gripper. Model the base, the motor mount (single motor underneath) and the gear linkage to the handles. Fully parameterized: add every dimension to params.json with docs and slider ranges so it appears in the live preview Tune panel. Must be swappable with any handle version: define a common handle-to-base interface so any 2.x handle fits. Every piece separable, each its own module and its own STL. Hardware context: our arm is the SO-101 (robot_config.md), which uses Feetech STS3215 servos; size the motor mount to that servo unless the design calls for something else. This starts the new 3.x line (gripper plus handles plus base) per AGENTS.md.
summary: Model the gripper 3.x base with a single underneath motor mount sized for the SO-101's STS3215 servo, plus gears linking to the handles. Make every dimension tunable in params.json, give each part its own STL, and define a common interface so any 2.x handle fits.
